# Now, let's prepare the new note for today.
# We'll update the date in the title to today, and change "ate_homemade_meals: no" to "ate_homemade_meals: yes" in the content.

new_title = f"Habit Log -- {today_str}"

# Update the content

# Prepare tags

# Create the new note
new_note = apis.simple_note.create_note(
    access_token=access_token,
    title=new_title,
    content=new_content,
    tags=tags,
    pinned=True
)
